$comment: grafana-logs-mcp machine requirements. Nothing here installs anything: both required values are machine-local Grafana coordinates, set through the server entry env (see config.example.json). Without them the server still starts and answers tools/list, but every tool call reports the missing configuration instead of guessing a target.

env.name: GRAFANA_URL
env.what: canonical base URL of the Grafana instance, e.g. https://grafana.example.net — redirects are rejected and embedded credentials are rejected

env.name: GRAFANA_DATASOURCE_UID
env.what: UID of the Quickwit datasource to query

env.name: GRAFANA_DATASOURCE_TYPE
env.what: overrides the Grafana datasource type plugin id; defaults to quickwit-quickwit-datasource

env.name: GRAFANA_API_TOKEN
env.what: optional Grafana service-account token or legacy API key, sent as a Bearer header; requires HTTPS and a valid bearer-token format
